findings.pdf_says: When an operand is textually subscripted, as operand-j_n (n printed as a subscript), the term 'operand-j' identifies a specific operand and 'n' refers to the nth position or occurrence of operand-j.

findings.why_it_matters: The clause defines the textual-subscript notation itself, and the subscript n was flattened onto the baseline, so the example reads as a term named 'operand-jn' and no longer shows the notation it defines.
